data.exact_reserve_text: The underwriting profit of GBP 6.0m in 2015 (2014, profit of GBP 7.0m) includes a release from prior year reserves of GBP 12.4m (2014, GBP 10.6m release).
data.standardized_narrative: Opening gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2015 was GBP 307.165m. Analysis of the gross claims development triangle indicates a net prioryear release of approximately GBP 19.17m (gross), driven by favourable development on the 2011 and 2012 underwriting years partially offset by adverse development on 2013. Management commentary reports a net release (after reinsurance) of GBP 12.4m. The syndicate has been managing an orderly run-off and transferred the 2013 year of account into Syndicate 3000 on 1 January 2016.
raw_causal_phrases: includes a release from prior year reserves of GBP 12.4m (2014, GBP 10.6m release).
Management currently believes the Syndicate's gross and net reserves are adequate.

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: Gross prioryear movement was calculated from the gross claims development triangle (presented in GBP '000). Management commentary reports a net prior year release of GBP 12.4m (after reinsurance); the gross movement computed from the triangle is a GBP 19.171m release. Where the report explicitly states only net prior year movement, that net figure is quoted in the commentary but the triangle was used to derive a gross figure. Triangle units are thousands (GBP '000). Lob-level prior year movements are not separately quantified in the report.
